summary: Discussion-sourced field reports and social threads highlight major vendor agent news (OpenAI Dots pause), new model releases (Qwen, Anthropic Sonnet), browser/MCP agent workflows, and multiple infra primitives for safer agent evals and runtime control. | Vendor/official updates: major product releases (OpenAI, Microsoft), new agent-focused platform features (Cursor, JetBrains, AWS Bedrock), sandbox/runtime tooling (E2B, Daytona, OpenRouter), and multiple GHSA advisories affecting agent stacks. | GitHub OSS snapshot: vendor agent-framework releases (Microsoft, Vercel, Cloudflare, OpenAI) dominate; large infra projects (Dify, Omnigent, Mastra) and browser-agent/security tooling rising. Missing social/operator discussion signals for adoption and pain points. | Package-layer signals show multiple vendor agent packages (OpenAI, Vercel, Salesforce, Sendbird) plus a wave of VS Code agent extensions, MCP tools, and security/observability libraries; social/user-workflow signals are missing from this shard.
